mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, embedding_id) VALUES (#{docId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{embeddingId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY chunk_index
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE doc_id = #{docId}

SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.doc_id AS docId, c.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, c.content, d.title, d.category, d.city, d.district, COALESCE(d.source_uri, CONCAT('doc-', d.id)) AS source, MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS score FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id WHERE d.status = 2 AND MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
